title: RespCCT and FreqCCT: Compact, Explainable and Cost-Aware Convolutional Transformers for Multi-Class Respiratory Disease Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.24323v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Chest auscultation depends on the listener, and software that classifies lung sounds could give a second reading where trained listeners are scarce. The most accurate published classifiers fine-tune large pretrained networks, and their accuracy is rarely reported with running cost or paired statistics. This study makes three contributions. (i) It proposes RespCCT and FreqCCT, two compact convolutional transformers of 173,187 and 124,999 parameters that learn from random initialization on mel, constant-Q and cepstral images of 5 s frames from three public databases, ICBHI, KAUH and RD@TR, with 1,665 audio files in seven classes. (ii) It compares both models with five ImageNet-pretrained networks and larger distilled variants on one test set, using paired bootstrap intervals. translated_title: RespCCT与FreqCCT：用于多类别呼吸疾病分类的紧凑、可解释且成本感知的卷积Transformer
translated_abstract: 胸部听诊的结果依赖于听诊者本人，而在缺乏训练有素的听诊人员时，能够对肺音进行分类的软件可以提供第二重判读。目前最精确的已发表分类器通常是对大型预训练网络进行微调，且其准确率很少与运行成本或配对统计信息一同报告。本研究做出了三项贡献：(i) 提出了RespCCT和FreqCCT两个紧凑的卷积Transformer，参数量分别为173,187和124,999，它们从随机初始化开始训练，输入为来自三个公开数据库（ICBHI、KAUH和RD@TR）的5秒音频帧转换成的梅尔频谱、恒定Q变换和倒谱图像，涵盖1,665个音频文件、七个类别。(ii) 在同一测试集上，采用配对bootstrap置信区间，将这两个模型与五个ImageNet预训练网络以及更大的蒸馏变体进行比较。(iii) 在单CPU线程上测量了流水线各阶段的计算成本，检验归因图是否依赖于训练得到的权重，并探究了模型学习到的特征（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出了两个仅约17万和12.5万参数的紧凑卷积Transformer（RespCCT与FreqCCT），从零训练即可在七个类别的呼吸疾病肺音分类中与大型预训练模型相媲美，同时显著降低计算成本并具备可解释性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes RespCCT and FreqCCT, two compact convolutional transformers with only ~173K and ~125K parameters trained from scratch, achieving competitive multi-class respiratory disease classification against large pretrained models while being more cost-efficient and explainable.
